verdict.rationale: Tailscale exposes a CLI, API, IaC and webhook integrations (tailscale-docs-12, tailscale-docs-18, tailscale-probe-3) that could in principle be scripted to act on many devices/users, but the evidence pack contains no documentation or example of an actual bulk operation (e.g., bulk-tagging devices, bulk user role changes, batch ACL updates) performed across many items at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation API/CLI examples, docs describing batch actions on multiple nodes/users, and any hands-on confirmation of such workflows.
